raw_text: Cache synchronous `localStorage`, `sessionStorage`, and `document.cookie` reads in memory. Use a `Map` (not a hook) for storage; update it on writes. Cache cookies with `cookieCache: Record<string, string> | null`. If storage can change externally, invalidate: `window.addEventListener('storage', (e) => { if (e.key) storageCache.delete(e.key)`. On `visibilitychange`, if `document.visibilityState === 'visible'`, invalidate cookie cache.
